title: 星河涡流 / Stellar currents
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party graph; MIT TiXL/GLM/Godot renderer and particle dependencies; outbound license pending

descriptions.zh-CN: 青蓝与熔金粒子沿两组演化流场织出长线，旋转残影与星尘形成深空层次。音量轻推发射密度。
descriptions.en-US: Cyan and molten-gold particles trace evolving currents, with rotating trails and distant stars. Audio gently modulates emission.
